comment: Worked out by hand: a 10 mm cube Block in the root moves into Arm (placed at x 50), where a second cube 10 mm further along x is joined to it (a 20 x 10 x 10 block from the origin, 2000); a 6 x 4 x 4 Pin made in Holder (turned 90 degrees about z and placed at y 30: x -4..0, y 30..36) moves into the root, where a move lifts it by 10 (96).
